people.name: Eun Chae Ni
people.note: Terminally ill until she gains the power to teleport whenever her heart rate spikes.

people.name: Lee Un Jeong
people.note: A civil servant with telekinetic powers, secretly Patient Number 3972 from the Wunderkinder experiments.

people.name: Kim Jeon Bok
people.note: Chae Ni's grandmother, who runs the Hearty House restaurant and once funded the Wunderkinder project as 'Madame King.'

people.name: Son Gyeong Un
people.note: Gains the power to stick to whatever he touches when he lies or panics.

people.name: Kang Ro Bin
people.note: Gains super strength when emotionally overwhelmed.

people.name: Ha Won Do
people.note: Wunderkinder leader who created the experiments that gave the group their powers.

people.name: Kim Pal Ho
people.note: A Wunderkinder who calls Dr Ha 'Father' and hunts down defective variants.

people.name: Seok Ju Ran
people.note: Uses brainwashing and hearing-based powers on Dr Ha's orders.

people.name: Seok Ho Ran
people.note: Uses hallucination powers and has secretly loved Un Jeong since childhood.

people.name: Yang Seok U
people.note: Civil servant and Un Jeong's supervisor at City Hall.

people.name: Kim Na Yeong
people.note: Seok U's junior colleague at the Civil Complaints office.

people.name: Moon Mi Hui
people.note: Gyeong Un's wife, who runs their flower shop.

people.name: Son Cheong
people.note: Gyeong Un's daughter.

people.name: Elder Yun
people.note: Elder of the Church of Eternal Salvation.

people.name: Park Seung Ryeol
people.note: A police officer investigating disappearances tied to the church.

people.name: Koo Jun Mo
people.note: Jeon Bok's accomplice, a former cop who helps search for Chae Ni.

people.name: Ko Sang Mu
people.note: A former orphanage janitor who once saved young Un Jeong from the lab fire.

people.name: Kim Bong Pal
people.note: A rag picker whose disappearance kicks off the mystery; a failed Wunderkinder experiment.

people.name: Choi Yeong Jun
people.note: Former director of Hawondo Lab and sponsor of its experiments.

people.name: Nam Sun Gyu
people.note: A wealthy old contact of Dr Ha's, hoping to be reborn as the Child of Eternity.

people.name: Jang Yun Hui
people.note: Un Jeong's mother, whom he has long searched for.

people.name: "Child of Eternity"
people.note: An orphan who could never die from the lab's experiments; his heart was transplanted into Chae Ni after he died.
